descriptions.read_file: Read a UTF-8 text file within the active workspace.
descriptions.write_file: Create or replace a UTF-8 text file within the active workspace.
descriptions.append_file: Append UTF-8 text to a file within the active workspace.
descriptions.list_files: List files below a workspace directory.
descriptions.search_files: Search text files below a workspace directory.
descriptions.run_command: Run a read-only command from the active workspace using the local whitelist.
descriptions.current_location: Resolve the user's current area through the operating-system location capability.
descriptions.current_weather: Get current weather after resolving the user's current area.
descriptions.open_camera: Open the system camera application when the user explicitly asks to use the camera.
descriptions.capture_camera: Capture one image for visual understanding. Use this automatically when the user asks what is in front of them, what they are looking at, what the camera sees, or asks to identify an object or scene; do not require the user to say 'open the camera'.
descriptions.ocr_image: Read text from an image through the pdfspine OCR connector. Decide when this is useful from the user's request.
descriptions.ocr_pdf: Read text from a PDF through the pdfspine OCR connector, including scanned pages.
descriptions.make_searchable_pdf: Create a searchable OCR text layer in a copy of a PDF through the pdfspine connector.
descriptions.request_capability: Open the macOS privacy settings page for a capability that needs user authorization.
descriptions.memory_recall: Search the user's private Jarvis memory for relevant facts, preferences, project context, or procedures.
descriptions.memory_save_core: Create or replace one bounded durable fact, preference, project fact, or reference in the user's private memory. Use your judgment for stable, clearly stated, or repeatedly confirmed information; do not save guesses or sensitive inferences. Recall and compare before replacing an existing fact.
descriptions.memory_save_episode: Save a bounded summary of a meaningful completed conversation or event when it will improve future continuity. Do not save routine small talk.
descriptions.memory_working_append: Append a bounded note to working memory when current task context should survive the next turn. Use your judgment; do not append every message.
descriptions.memory_search_procedures: Search the user's saved reusable procedures and workflows.
descriptions.memory_save_procedure: Create or replace a reusable procedure in the user's private memory when a workflow is stable and clearly established. Ask before deleting or replacing a conflicting procedure.
